issues.title: World orientation still requires a whole-Profile scan
issues.expected: A user growing one small world can narrow Context orientation to that world while retaining current/grant annotations.
issues.actual: Every `contexts` attempt emitted the same 112-row, 7,671-byte Profile inventory; the relevant current `practice` row was visible, but there is no operand to focus this operation on the world.
issues.workaround: Visually locate `practice` once, then use explicit Context operands for all other operations.

issues.title: Successful Chunk receipts omit all created Memory UIDs
issues.expected: A mutating receipt names every new Memory so its output can directly feed Edit, Move, Reference, or later Chunk operations.
issues.actual: All five successful three-way clause splits showed the proposed text and only `Done — 3 memories added`; no created UID appeared. Later exact List/Show was required to recover selectors.
issues.workaround: Immediately run exact List or Show and match the new fragment bodies and placement to recover their UIDs.

issues.title: Clause Chunk repeatedly creates context-dependent Memories
issues.expected: Each resulting Memory remains independently meaningful or retains an explicit typed relation to the neighboring fragments needed to interpret it.
issues.actual: Every split emitted dependent fragments such as `this edited duplicate retains the original`, `assertion.`, `copied from the original direct Memory for`, `provenance.`, and `unresolved alternatives remain explicit.` The first ambiguity review then flagged one such fragment because its referent and retention meaning were unclear.
issues.workaround: Avoid clause Chunk for compact claims, or immediately review and Edit/Meld the fragments before treating them as independent Memories.
issues.reproduction: 5/5 splits produced at least one dependent fragment

issues.title: Find Ambiguities repeatedly loses the whole result on a NONE/question decoder mismatch
issues.expected: Return a validated finding set or a stable empty report for the frozen Source frame.
issues.actual: Rounds 2–5 failed after provider work with `Codex find_ambiguities returned a question for NONE.` No usable report was returned. The active Context-tree digest stayed unchanged, so the failure was atomic but not recoverable from a partial result.
issues.workaround: Preserve the Source frame and retry; use Query/Find Conflicts for partial review, but neither substitutes for an ambiguity report. The repeated controls show retry is not reliable.
issues.reproduction: 4/5 attempts; round 1 was the successful control

issues.title: Recursive Summary drops the small world's direct mappings behind larger descendants
issues.expected: A recursive summary of `practice` represents the direct root claims as well as the larger descendant policy corpus, especially after deliberate mapping conflicts are visible.
issues.actual: Rounds 2 and 4 summarized only the pre-existing editing/verification descendants. They omitted all direct a→apple claims in round 2 and all direct/root-visible a/b mappings and the b conflict in round 4, even though the adjacent Show/Find/Query routes exposed them.
issues.workaround: Summarize each exact Context separately or ask a focused Query, then combine the results manually.
issues.reproduction: 2/2 recursive summaries after mappings existed; direct-source summaries were useful controls

issues.title: Renaming a Branch/checkout target corrupts the global Undo/Redo stack
issues.expected: After a successful Rename of a Context created by Branch or checkout -b, the retained producer unit remains reconstructible under the new canonical name, so later Undo/Redo can host-read and restore its exact UID/member set.
issues.actual: Rename#1, #2, and #3 succeeded. Thereafter every global stack build and each counted Undo/Redo control failed closed with `Branch checkpoint owner is outside its creation membership.` The renamed checkpoint owner uses the new Context name while the branch receipt's creation membership retains the old target name.
issues.workaround: Do not Rename a Branch/checkout-created Context while its producer remains in command history. Use explicit per-Context checkpoints/revert for recovery; there is no global Undo workaround once this mismatch exists.
issues.reproduction: 3 successful renames followed by 8/8 Undo/Redo failures across rounds 2-5
